verses.original: Χριστοῦ οὖν παθόντος σαρκὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς τὴν αὐτὴν ἔννοιαν ὁπλίσασθε ὅτι ὁ παθὼν σαρκὶ πέπαυται ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: Christou oun pathontos sarki kai hymeis tēn autēn ennoian hoplisasthe hoti ho pathōn sarki pepautai hamartias
verses.literal: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body - arm yourselves with the same resolve because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin
verses.literalPt: ORA, pois, já que Cristo padeceu por nós na carne, armai-vos também vós com este pensamento, que aquele que padeceu na carne já cessou do pecado;

verses.original: εἰς τὸ μηκέτι ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαις ἀλλὰ θελήματι Θεοῦ τὸν ἐπίλοιπον ἐν σαρκὶ βιῶσαι χρόνον
verses.transliteration: eis to mēketi anthrōpōn epithymiais alla thelēmati Theou ton epiloipon en sarki biōsai chronon
verses.literal: Consequently he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions but for the will of God
verses.literalPt: Para que, no tempo que vos resta na carne, não vivais mais segundo as concupiscências dos homens, mas segundo a vontade de Deus.

verses.original: ἀρκετὸς γὰρ ὁ παρεληλυθὼς χρόνος τὸ βούλημα τῶν ἐθνῶν κατειργάσθαι πεπορευμένους ἐν ἀσελγείαις ἐπιθυμίαις οἰνοφλυγίαις κώμοις πότοις καὶ ἀθεμίτοις εἰδωλολατρίαις
verses.transliteration: arketos gar ho parelēlythōs chronos to boulēma tōn ethnōn kateirgasthai peporeumenous en aselgeiais epithymiais oinophlygiais kōmois potois kai athemitois eidōlolatriais
verses.literal: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles living in debauchery lust drunkenness orgies carousing and detestable idolatry
verses.literalPt: Porque é bastante que no tempo passado da vida fizéssemos a vontade dos gentios, andando em dissoluções, concupiscências, borrachices, glutonarias, bebedices e abomináveis idolatrias;

verses.original: Ἐν ᾧ ξενίζονται μὴ συντρεχόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀσωτίας ἀνάχυσιν βλασφημοῦντες
verses.transliteration: En hō xenizontai mē syntrechontōn hymōn eis tēn autēn tēs asōtias anachysin blasphēmountes
verses.literal: Because of this they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion and they heap abuse on you
verses.literalPt: E acham estranho não correrdes com eles no mesmo desenfreamento de dissolução, blasfemando de vós.

verses.original: οἳ ἀποδώσουσιν λόγον τῷ ἑτοίμως ἔχοντι κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς
verses.transliteration: hoi apodōsousin logon tō hetoimōs echonti krinai zōntas kai nekrous
verses.literal: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead
verses.literalPt: Os quais hão de dar conta ao que está preparado para julgar os vivos e os mortos.

verses.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ νεκροῖς εὐηγγελίσθη ἵνα κριθῶσι μὲν κατὰ ἀνθρώπους σαρκί ζῶσι δὲ κατὰ Θεὸν πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: eis touto gar kai nekrois euēngelisthē hina krithōsi men kata anthrōpous sarki zōsi de kata Theon pneumati
verses.literal: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead so that they might be judged as men in the flesh but live according to God in the spirit
verses.literalPt: Porque por isto foi pregado o evangelho também aos mortos, para que, na verdade, fossem julgados segundo os homens na carne, mas vivessem segundo Deus em espírito;

verses.original: Πάντων δὲ τὸ τέλος ἤγγικεν σωφρονήσατε οὖν καὶ νήψατε εἰς προσευχάς
verses.transliteration: Pantōn de to telos ēngiken sōphronēsate oun kai nēpsate eis proseuchas
verses.literal: The end of all things is near Therefore be clear-minded and sober so that you can pray
verses.literalPt: E já está próximo o fim de todas as coisas; portanto sede sóbrios e vigiai em oração.

verses.original: πρὸ πάντων τὴν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀγάπην ἐκτενῆ ἔχοντες ὅτι ἀγάπη καλύπτει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: pro pantōn tēn eis heautous agapēn ektenē echontes hoti agapē kalyptei plēthos hamartiōn
verses.literal: Above all love one another deeply because love covers over a multitude of sins
verses.literalPt: Mas, sobretudo, tende ardente amor uns para com os outros; porque o amor cobrirá a multidão de pecados.

verses.literal: Show hospitality to one another without complaining
verses.literalPt: Sendo hospitaleiros uns para com os outros, sem murmurações,

verses.original: ἕκαστος καθὼς ἔλαβεν χάρισμα εἰς ἑαυτοὺς αὐτὸ διακονοῦντες ὡς καλοὶ οἰκονόμοι ποικίλης χάριτος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hekastos kathōs elaben charisma eis heautous auto diakonountes hōs kaloi oikonomoi poikilēs charitos Theou
verses.literal: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another
verses.literalPt: Cada um administre aos outros o dom como o recebeu, como bons despenseiros da multiforme graça de Deus.

verses.original: εἴ τις λαλεῖ ὡς λόγια Θεοῦ εἴ τις διακονεῖ ὡς ἐξ ἰσχύος ἧς χορηγεῖ ὁ Θεός ἵνα ἐν πᾶσιν δοξάζηται ὁ Θεὸς διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ᾧ ἐστιν ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: ei tis lalei hōs logia Theou ei tis diakonei hōs ex ischyos hēs chorēgei ho Theos hina en pasin doxazētai ho Theos dia Iēsou Christou hō estin hē doxa kai to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: If anyone speaks he should speak as one conveying the words of God If anyone serves he should serve with the strength - God provides so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever Amen
verses.literalPt: Se alguém falar, fale segundo as palavras de Deus; se alguém administrar, administre segundo o poder que Deus dá; para que em tudo Deus seja glorificado por Jesus Cristo, a quem pertence a glória e poder para todo o sempre. Amém.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί μὴ ξενίζεσθε τῇ ἐν ὑμῖν πυρώσει πρὸς πειρασμὸν ὑμῖν γινομένῃ ὡς ξένου ὑμῖν συμβαίνοντος
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi mē xenizesthe tē en hymin pyrōsei pros peirasmon hymin ginomenē hōs xenou hymin symbainontos
verses.literal: Beloved do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you as though something strange were happening to you
verses.literalPt: Amados, não estranheis a ardente prova que vem sobre vós para vos tentar, como se coisa estranha vos acontecesse;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὸ κοινωνεῖτε τοῖς τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθήμασιν χαίρετε ἵνα καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ χαρῆτε ἀγαλλιώμενοι
verses.transliteration: alla katho koinōneite tois tou Christou pathēmasin chairete hina kai en tē apokalypsei tēs doxēs autou charēte agalliōmenoi
verses.literal: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ so that . . . you may be overjoyed . . . at the revelation of His glory
verses.literalPt: Mas alegrai-vos no fato de serdes participantes das aflições de Cristo, para que também na revelação da sua glória vos regozijeis e alegreis.

verses.original: Εἰ ὀνειδίζεσθε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ μακάριοι ὅτι τὸ τῆς δόξης καὶ τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ Πνεῦμα ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἀναπαύεται
verses.transliteration: Ei oneidizesthe en onomati Christou makarioi hoti to tēs doxēs kai to tou Theou Pneuma eph’ hymas anapauetai
verses.literal: If you are insulted for the name of Christ you are blessed because the Spirit of glory and - of God rests on you
verses.literalPt: Se pelo nome de Cristo sois vituperados, bem-aventurados sois, porque sobre vós repousa o Espírito da glória e de Deus; quanto a eles, é ele, sim, blasfemado, mas quanto a vós, é glorificado.

verses.original: μὴ γάρ τις ὑμῶν πασχέτω ὡς φονεὺς ἢ κλέπτης ἢ κακοποιὸς ἢ ὡς ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος
verses.transliteration: mē gar tis hymōn paschetō hōs phoneus ē kleptēs ē kakopoios ē hōs allotriepiskopos
verses.literal: Indeed none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer or even as a meddler
verses.literalPt: Que nenhum de vós padeça como homicida, ou ladrão, ou malfeitor, ou como o que se entremete em negócios alheios;

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ὡς Χριστιανός μὴ αἰσχυνέσθω δοξαζέτω δὲ τὸν Θεὸν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: ei de hōs Christianos mē aischynesthō doxazetō de ton Theon en tō onomati toutō
verses.literal: But if you suffer as a Christian do not be ashamed but glorify God that you bear that name
verses.literalPt: Mas, se padece como cristão, não se envergonhe, antes glorifique a Deus nesta parte.

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ ἄρξασθαι τὸ κρίμα ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰ δὲ πρῶτον ἀφ’ ἡμῶν τί τὸ τέλος τῶν ἀπειθούντων τῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ εὐαγγελίῳ
verses.transliteration: hoti ho kairos tou arxasthai to krima apo tou oikou tou Theou ei de prōton aph’ hēmōn ti to telos tōn apeithountōn tō tou Theou euangeliō
verses.literal: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God and if it begins with us what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God
verses.literalPt: Porque já é tempo que comece o julgamento pela casa de Deus; e, se primeiro começa por nós, qual será o fim daqueles que são desobedientes ao evangelho de Deus?

verses.original: καὶ Εἰ ὁ δίκαιος μόλις σώζεται ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται
verses.transliteration: kai Ei ho dikaios molis sōzetai ho asebēs kai hamartōlos pou phaneitai
verses.literal: And If it is hard for the righteous to be saved what will become of the ungodly and the sinner
verses.literalPt: E, se o justo apenas se salva, onde aparecerá o ímpio e o pecador?

verses.original: Ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ πιστῷ Κτίστῃ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hōste kai hoi paschontes kata to thelēma tou Theou pistō Ktistē paratithesthōsan tas psychas autōn en agathopoiia
verses.literal: So then . . . those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good
verses.literalPt: Portanto também os que padecem segundo a vontade de Deus encomendem-lhe as suas almas, como ao fiel Criador, fazendo o bem.
